market_summary: During the London session, markets across metals, FX, US equity futures, and crypto are broadly exhibiting consolidation inside their respective session Value Areas, predominantly pinned near fair-value POCs or baseline means (VWAP/EMA50). RVOL across all assets remains below the 2.0 breakout threshold with absence of yellow volume spikes. With risk assets structurally below declining session VWAP/EMA50 baselines but lacking expansion volume or clean liquidity sweep follow-through, patience is favored until the London/NY overlap and NY cash open provide decisive order flow.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 3884.20 to VAH 3911.53) and hovering right at POC 3896.98 (signal candle closed below at 3893.18). During LONDON_SESSION, price remains below downsloping VWAP (3902.82) and EMA50 (3901.22), reflecting structural bearish pressure. CVD is BEARISH at -2.08 with a negative slope of -0.02, agreeing with broader session weakness. Price is consolidating mid-channel between the ATR lower band (3884.96) and upper band (3915.99) after a minor bounce off S/R support at 3887.45. However, RVOL is low at 0.965 with no yellow volume spike (>2.0) to support continuation or a sustained reversal. GEX is null outside NY cash hours. Given the position directly at the fair-value POC magnet inside the Value Area without volume confirmation, a clear edge is lacking.

Price has pulled back inside the Value Area to POC 1.32349 (VAL 1.32271 to VAH 1.32378) after a brief probe above VAH. In the LONDON_SESSION, price is trading marginally above VWAP (1.32325) and right on EMA50 (1.32346), indicating directionless chop. CVD is BEARISH at -2550, diverging from the intraday upward attempt, though cvd_slope is positive at +1698. Price is located in the upper half of the ATR channel (upper band 1.32440, lower band 1.32211) following a clean wick rejection off S/R 1.32391 and Session High 1.32431. Volume is moderate at RVOL 1.386 without any yellow spike (>2.0) confirming expansion. GEX is null on FX. Caught between immediate overhead resistance and session baseline inside the Value Area, setup warrants a hold.
